comments.body:
SESSION CLOSEOUT 2026-08-05 -- scheduled mirror CI, ticket-status audit, Bedrock unblock.

DELIVERED (both landed through the two Gerrit gates and closed):

1. 03ef-6fb5-158b-4abd -- CLOSED. Merged as 676c85e604. GitHub-mirror main CI now runs on a
   schedule instead of on push. Root cause it fixes: test.yml, prompt-eval.yml and codeql.yml
   keyed concurrency on github.ref with cancel-in-progress, and on main that ref is the constant
   refs/heads/main, so every push cancelled its predecessor and GitHub rendered a healthy main as
   a trail of red X. Operator cadence decision: every 6 hours.
   - test.yml 41 star/6, optionality.yml 47 star/6, verify-identity.yml 53 star/6; all three also
     add main to branches-ignore. Push CI for every other branch is unchanged.
   - prompt-eval.yml drops push-on-main but KEEPS its weekly cron (billable live tier).
   - codeql.yml and terraform-drift.yml drop the push key outright.
   - External integrations did not get more frequent: external-integration.yml untouched, weekly.
   - Separate mechanisms untouched and verified absent from the diff: gerrit-verify.yaml, both
     reconcilers, mirror-guard.yml, every underscore-prefixed reusable. Pre-merge gating cannot
     have shifted -- proven by this change itself earning Verified +1 through that untouched path.
   - Pays back the lost per-commit attribution: new caller-level main-health-report job resolves
     the last known-green main SHA from the workflow run history and, on a red run, emits a
     copy-pasteable git bisect recipe wired to the same gates CI runs. Logic lives in
     scripts/main_health_report.py with the gh call injected as a Runner, so tests exercise every
     failure mode without a network.
   - Completion verifier PASS on 26 criteria. Note it explicitly scoped AC22 (lint/typecheck
     green) OUT; that claim rests on a local make check run and CI Verified +1, not the verifier.

2. 34b5-ad7d-b983-47f9 -- CLOSED. Merged as 90a6a07e522. CodeQL joins the same 6-hourly tick at
   35 star/6, staggered against 41/47/53. Filed by the 03ef agent as a discovered_from tradeoff:
   dropping push-on-main had silently promoted the weekly cron from a between-pushes backstop to
   the PRIMARY scan, stretching worst-case exposure for a new finding to seven days. Operator
   decided 6-hourly. Repo is PUBLIC, so CodeQL and Actions minutes are free and the previously
   recorded 28x-cost rationale did not apply; that stale header comment was rewritten rather than
   left to contradict the config.

DECISION PARKED:
   6117-fcb7-d680-4b2f -- moved open to IDEA. The vacuous-checks lifecycle recommendation
   (nine instances in one session; six CLOSED prior-art tickets show the family recurs because
   past work was remedial and left no preventive mechanism). Three open questions remain
   unanswered by design: adopt one/two/all three parts; CI meta-gate blocking vs warn-only;
   retrofit vs new-only. Do not decompose or implement until the operator revisits.

STATUS AUDIT of all 17 in_progress tickets. Eleven were accurate (0303/30d3/561e/6981 blocked on
the operator quiet window; 9b71/facb active; 28cd/e1b1/c9f7/70bc in-flight with open changes).
No status was flipped -- each remaining case needed evidence, not a transition, so findings were
recorded as comments:
   - 6a81 -- code merged (21e3849190) but a SIGNED COMPLETION VERDICT OF FAIL is on record with
     two high findings, both "the test does not assert the criterion it exists to prove". This is
     an instance of the same family tracked on 6117. NOT a free close.
   - bf31 -- merged (85805e02f11d) but the RCA measured roughly 88s of deterministic pre-LLM CPU
     that CONTRADICTS docs/llm-framework.md around 680-683, with no ticket covering it. Closing
     bf31 would silently drop that.
   - 9416 and 9ec0 -- two finished, review-quality commits (036ca3c16d, ecb71a79f8) sitting
     UNPUSHED for roughly 40h in worktrees, no owner, no live process. Cheapest value available.
   - 8fc2 -- epic idle 13h with zero comments, so deliberate parking cannot be distinguished from
     drift. Flagged rather than changed, because an unexplained transition destroys the signal.
   - 94a3 -- merge independently confirmed; close still blocked by the completion-verifier loop
     (46a2) owned by another session.

METHODOLOGY WARNING WORTH KEEPING: 4-char short ids COLLIDE in this store. Commit f31b5e10eb86
has subject "0303: record bridge-state format ADR" but its trailer is rebar-ticket: abb6-... , a
CHILD of 0303. Grepping a short id and reading the subject produced three wrong conclusions
earlier in this session. Always match the FULL id in the trailer and read the commit message.

ENVIRONMENT: the Bedrock grammar-compilation failure (895c) is FIXED on main as d8adf0f5654.
The stopgap used during this session -- pointing REBAR_LLM_STANDARD_MODEL and
REBAR_LLM_TRIVIAL_MODEL at bedrock opus-4-8 -- is retired. Attestations earned under it are
GENUINE: the override made the gate actually run, which is how 03ef surfaced a real blocking
finding (a missing actions:read + GH_TOKEN precondition) that the broken gate had been hiding
behind a zero-blocking INDETERMINATE. No --force was used anywhere this session.

ADDENDUM to the 2026-08-05 closeout -- detail from the 34b5 agent's final report, worth keeping.

1. BEDROCK FIX CONFIRMED END-TO-END, independently of the ticket that fixed it. The 34b5 agent
   ran plan-review UNDER the opus-4-8 override (log line confirmed claude-opus-4-8, not
   sonnet-4-6) and earned a certified attestation. By close time its worktree had been
   fast-forwarded onto the merged commit, which contains d8adf0f5654; it verified that with
   git merge-base --is-ancestor BEFORE dropping the exports, then ran the CLOSE GATE with both
   env vars UNSET -- and it passed on its own. So the fix is confirmed working on a real gate
   run, not just asserted. No --force anywhere.

2. THE ANTI-VACUITY PRACTICE 6117 RECOMMENDS WAS APPLIED VOLUNTARILY AGAIN, and it paid. The
   agent did RED-first (2 tests failed for the right reason against unchanged config, then
   61/61 green) plus a FIVE-MUTATION sweep: minute collision with test.yml, on-the-hour minute,
   weekly cron kept alongside the new one, push-on-main reintroduced, workflow_dispatch removed.
   Every mutation was caught by its intended assertion INCLUDING the retained cover, which is
   what proves the retarget lost nothing rather than merely looking green. This is now the
   fourth or fifth change this session where mutation proof was done voluntarily and was the
   decisive evidence -- more support for 6117's item 3 (make mutation proof the expectation for
   check-modifying changes), which is the cheapest of its three parts.

   Real design constraint it surfaced: CodeQL could NOT simply be added to the _SIX_HOURLY
   tuple in tests/unit/test_ci_main_push_policy.py, because that tuple also drives
   test_push_ci_for_non_main_branches_is_preserved and CodeQL has no push trigger at all. A
   naive join would have failed. Handled with a separate _SIX_HOURLY_SCHEDULE_ONLY tuple.

3. TWO TEST CAVEATS, both benign and both honestly reported:
   - test_agent_build_invariants::test_real_anthropic_model_supports_tools ERRORed with "Test
     moved the repo HEAD" because the agent committed while the suite was running. Passes in
     isolation. Self-inflicted, not a defect.
   - test_coverage_reconstruction::test_full_backend_account_is_present fails on the metric
     backend. Proved PRE-EXISTING by checking out the unmodified base commit 676c85e604 and
     reproducing it identically; CI is green on it. Environmental to this host. Accepted, not
     filed. Same failure was independently observed by the 03ef agent.

4. The 34b5 agent kept its own session log at 0c55-4493-b95a-47a4.
